name: ir-marker
description: Oriented rectangle over the strobe response's bright mass: lit-minus-unlit infrared above threshold gives zeroth/first/second moments, whose principal axes and eigenvalue half extents produce four corners assuming a uniform rectangular reflector — retroreflective tape on a real wall becomes a tracked painting frame another probe's sockets can bind.

threshold.description: The strobe-response floor a pixel must clear to weigh into the mass.

gain.description: The multiplier that maps raw lit-minus-unlit luminance to a 0..1 response.

minCoverage.description: The coverage fraction confidence saturates at.
